text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Huuuh.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Nnnghhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I can't draw!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm just not feeling it...! There's no 
passion in this whatsoever...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going for a walk.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I really want some momentum, you 
know? Like the kind of momentum where you 
just swoosh and draw...

Hyohyohyohyohyo! It won't stop, my pen 
just won't stooop!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...! That voice...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fuhohohohohoho! I have witnessed something 
wonderful! This is going to make for an 
incredible new release!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hold on just a moment, my fellow comrades! 
This time as well, I have poured in every 
ounce of my love, passion, and moe for Uma 
Musume-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I'm sho looking forward to it~~! 
Diving into mountains of treasure, 
exchanging receipt-length detailed 
impressions... *drools*

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Clashing your "passions" against each 
other to connect. Creating things for that 
purpose—I get it, that's super fun...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I feel like my spirits just lifted a 
little bit...!
choice_data_list:
Maybe your passion rubbed off on them or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! Then if I could get more 
inspiration...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't really create art to show 
people, though."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, what I glimpsed in your notebook 
looked wonderful! It's a splendid creative 
work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...That's not what I meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You know how it is, right? You copy a 
manga you like or something you see... 
just a little bit. And you think, 'Hey, 
that actually turned out pretty well.'
choice_data_list: I might have done it before...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Drawing what resonated in your heart, 
by yourself, for yourself, as if 
whispering it softly. Ah, wonderful... 
that's wonderful too...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haa, what a cute picture book...! 
Rice-senpai, how do you manage to write 
stories that feel just like a gentle 
spring breeze?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, thank you. You know, just like 
how the 'Blue Rose of Happiness' made Rice 
feel so warm and happy—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If someone... could smile just a little 
reading the story Rice drew, that would 
make me so happy. That's what Rice thinks 
about while drawing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. It really warms your heart 
when the people around you are happy, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I might not write the stories, but 
still... Drawing is so much fun, and if it 
brings people joy, that makes me even 
happier, you know?
choice_data_list:
So both the person who draws it and the 
people who see it end up happy, huh

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's here, it's finally here...! Finding 
happiness through creating—that's the 
answer...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Man, everyone's making such great 
stuff...! ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Around her as she paints, a razor-sharp, 
icy air flows that keeps all others at 
bay. However—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Ramonu-senpai, please tell me your 
story!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wah... it's abstract art! It looks 
professional, that's amazing!! Are you 
going to submit it to a contest?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? E-Even though it's this amazing? Why 
not!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Unnecessary. Insolent gazes have no place 
upon this painting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: âSuch inquisitive eyes.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Because I can't help but wonder! I can't 
take my eyes off it, and my heart is 
pounding so fast...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If it were me... I'd deliver it. I'm sure 
you'd want someone to see it. To make 
someone happy."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I see. You love it too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“—The reason I face the canvas. It is out 
of love.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The longer we are apart, the more my 
heart burns. And the place where it all 
overflows is—right here."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Love letters are not something to flaunt 
about.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Understood...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A work drawn with someone in mind! 
That means you're already happy while 
drawing it, so it's already complete right 
then and there!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A world just for the two of them, where no 
one else may intrude... Man, the creative 
process behind a work is quite the story 
in itself...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Everyone really does have their own 
reasons to create. They all resonated with 
me. I feel like I can draw now!"
choice_data_list:
Charging in with everyone was totally 
worth it...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Honestly, it's just overflowing right 
now. My creative passion, that is...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to lose to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere in this academy, someone else is 
creating today too. Knowing that seemed to 
give Kiseki the push she needed.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it wasn't an ambush or anything. 
How should I put it... I guess I just 
naturally felt a sense of camaraderie!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I hope I can find it again~ Where will it 
be next time~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Driven purely by passion, Kiseki was 
fearless in a sense.
